2. 
```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Keep geographic and categorical codes as strings
    id_mn_resi = as.character(id_mn_resi),
    sg_uf = as.character(sg_uf),
    nu_ano = as.character(nu_ano),
    ano_nasc = as.character(ano_nasc),
    cs_sexo = as.character(cs_sexo),
    cs_raca = as.character(cs_raca),
    agente_tox = as.character(agente_tox),
    lavoura = as.character(lavoura),
    circunstan = as.character(circunstan),
    evolucao = as.character(evolucao),
    sit_trab = as.character(sit_trab),
    hospital = as.character(hospital),

    # Convert years to numeric
    ano_origem_num = as.numeric(ano_origem),
    nu_ano_num = as.numeric(nu_ano),
    ano_nasc_num = as.numeric(ano_nasc),

    # Parse dates flexibly
    dt_notific_date = as_date(parse_date_time(
      dt_notific,
      orders = c("ymd", "dmy", "mdy")
    )),
    dt_sin_pri_date = as_date(parse_date_time(
      dt_sin_pri,
      orders = c("ymd", "dmy", "mdy")
    )),

    # Derived age at notification
    age = nu_ano_num - ano_nasc_num,

    # Days between symptom onset and notification
    days_symptom_to_notification = as.numeric(dt_notific_date - dt_sin_pri_date),

    # Agricultural context: non-empty LAVOURA
    agricultural_context = case_when(
      is.na(lavoura) | str_trim(lavoura) == "" ~ "No crop recorded",
      TRUE ~ "Crop recorded"
    ),

    # Sex label
    sex_label = case_when(
      cs_sexo == "M" ~ "Male",
      cs_sexo == "F" ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ "Missing/Unknown"
    ),

    # Race/ethnicity label
    race_label = case_when(
      cs_raca == "1" ~ "White",
      cs_raca == "2" ~ "Black",
      cs_raca == "3" ~ "Asian/Yellow",
      cs_raca == "4" ~ "Brown/Pardo",
      cs_raca == "5" ~ "Indigenous",
      TRUE ~ "Missing/Unknown"
    ),

    # Outcome label
    outcome_label = case_when(
      evolucao == "1" ~ "Cure",
      evolucao == "2" ~ "Death from notified condition",
      evolucao == "3" ~ "Death from other cause",
      evolucao == "4" ~ "Lost to follow-up",
      evolucao == "5" ~ "Transfer",
      evolucao == "9" ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ "Missing"
    ),

    # Hospitalisation label
    hospitalised_label = case_when(
      hospital == "1" ~ "Yes",
      hospital == "2" ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ "Missing/Unknown"
    ),

    # Circumstance: occupational accident
    occupational_accident = case_when(
      circunstan  == "02" ~ "Occupational accident",
      is.na(circunstan) | str_trim(circunstan) == "" ~ "Missing",
      TRUE ~ "Other circumstance"
    )
  )

glimpse(df)
```

4. Missingness Summary 

```{r missingness-summary}
is_missing_value <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    is.na(x) | str_trim(x) == ""
  } else {
    is.na(x)
  }
}

missing_summary <- df %>%
  summarise(across(
    everything(),
    list(
      missing_n = ~sum(is_missing_value(.)),
      missing_pct = ~mean(is_missing_value(.)) * 100
    ),
    .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
  )) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("variable", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.+)_(missing_n|missing_pct)"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing_pct))

missing_summary %>%
  mutate(missing_pct = round(missing_pct, 2)) %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Missingness summary by variable",
    col.names = c("Variable", "Missing n", "Missing %")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

5. Visualisation: missingness

```{r missingness-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
missingness_plot <- missing_summary %>%
  filter(missing_pct > 0) %>%
  mutate(variable = fct_reorder(variable, missing_pct)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = variable, y = missing_pct)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2C7FB8") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Missingness by variable",
    subtitle = "Only variables with missingness are shown",
    x = "Variable",
    y = "Missing values (%)"
  )

missingness_plot

)
```


6. Categorical summaries

```{r categorical-summary-function}
summarise_categorical <- function(data, var) {
  
  data %>%
    mutate(
      category = as.character(.data[[var]]),
      category = if_else(
        is.na(category) | str_trim(category) == "",
        "Missing",
        category
      )
    ) %>%
    count(category, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(
      variable = var,
      percent = 100 * n / sum(n)
    ) %>%
    select(variable, category, n, percent) %>%
    arrange(variable, desc(n))
}
```

```{r categorical-summary}
categorical_summary <- map_dfr(
  categorical_vars,
  ~summarise_categorical(df, .x)
)

categorical_summary %>%
  mutate(percent = round(percent, 2)) %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Categorical variable summary: n and %",
    col.names = c("Variable", "Category", "n", "%") 
#variable -Name of the categorical variable , category -Category/code/value, n - Absolute frequency/count,percent-Relative frequency/percentage
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r top-10-municipalities, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
top10_municipalities <- df %>%
```

---------------------------------------------
Maps for SINAN Data - Pesticide Notifications
---------------------------------------------

```{r}
# Read shapefile
sp_municipios <- st_read("/Users/abiramisomasundaram/Desktop/Brazil pesticides/Workspace/SHAPEFILES FOR MAPS-SAO PAULO BRAZIL/SP_Municipios_2025_with 6 digit/SP_Municipios_2025/SP_Municipios_2025.shp")

pop_df <- read_parquet("/Users/abiramisomasundaram/Desktop/Brazil pesticides/Data/Dados Version 2/Dados/resultados/contextual/populacao_sp_municipio_ano.parquet")

# Clean shapefile
sp_municipios_clean <- sp_municipios %>%
  mutate(
    muni_code = as.character(COD_6),
    muni_code = str_trim(muni_code),
    muni_name = as.character(NM_MUN)
  ) %>%
  st_make_valid()
```
Annual Pesticide Notification Count from exsisting df
```{r}
yearly_notifications <- df %>%
  mutate(
    muni_code = as.character(id_mn_resi),
    muni_code = str_trim(muni_code),
    year = as.integer(nu_ano_num)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(muni_code),
    muni_code != "",
    !is.na(year)
  ) %>%
  count(muni_code, year, name = "n_notifications")

years_available <- sort(unique(yearly_notifications$year))

```

Clean population data

```{r}
population_clean <- pop_df %>%
  mutate(
    muni_code = as.character(cod_ibge),
    muni_code = str_trim(muni_code),
    year = as.integer(ano),
    populacao = as.numeric(populacao)
  ) %>%
  group_by(muni_code, year) %>%
  summarise(
    population = sum(populacao, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

# Municipality-year grid
```{r}

municipality_year_grid <- expand_grid(
  muni_code = sp_municipios_clean$muni_code,
  year = years_available
)

```

# Calculate rates
```{r}
yearly_rates <- municipality_year_grid %>%
  left_join(yearly_notifications, by = c("muni_code", "year")) %>%
  left_join(population_clean, by = c("muni_code", "year")) %>%
  mutate(
    n_notifications = replace_na(n_notifications, 0),
    notification_rate_100k = if_else(
      !is.na(population) & population > 0,
      100000 * n_notifications / population,
      NA_real_
    )
  )
```

# Join to shapefile
```{r}

sp_map_yearly_rates <- sp_municipios_clean %>%
  left_join(yearly_rates, by = "muni_code") %>%
  st_transform(4326)

```

# Create Rate Categories
```{r}
# Create rate categories
sp_map_yearly_rates <- sp_map_yearly_rates %>%
  mutate(
    rate_category = cut(
      notification_rate_100k,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 0, 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, Inf),
      labels = c(
        "0",
        ">0–1",
        ">1–5",
        ">5–10",
        ">10–25",
        ">25–50",
        ">50–100",
        ">100"
      ),
      right = TRUE
    )
  )
```


# Static Maps 
```{r}
# Years to show
selected_years <- c(2014, 2017, 2021, 2024)

# Make sure year is numeric/integer
sp_map_selected_proj <- sp_map_yearly_rates %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(year)) %>%
  filter(year %in% selected_years) %>%
  st_transform(5880)

#Rate Categories
sp_map_selected_proj <- sp_map_selected_proj %>%
  mutate(
    rate_category = cut(
      notification_rate_100k,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 0, 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, Inf),
      labels = c(
        "0",
        ">0–1",
        ">1–5",
        ">5–10",
        ">10–25",
        ">25–50",
        ">50–100",
        ">100"
      ),
      right = TRUE
    )
  )
#labels the municipality with the highest rate in each selected year.
label_data <- sp_map_selected_proj %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(notification_rate_100k),
    n_notifications >= 5
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  slice_max(notification_rate_100k, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    label_text = paste0(
      muni_name,
      "\nRate: ",
      round(notification_rate_100k, 1),
      " per 100k",
      "\nn = ",
      n_notifications
    )
  ) %>%
  st_point_on_surface()


```

SISAUGA DATA 
--------------------------------


```{r}
 #File paths
parquet_path <- "/Users/abiramisomasundaram/Desktop/Brazil pesticides/Data/Dados Version 2/Dados/resultados/base_consolidada_sp_2014_2024.parquet"
shapefile_path <- "/Users/abiramisomasundaram/Desktop/Brazil pesticides/Workspace/SHAPEFILES FOR MAPS-SAO PAULO BRAZIL/SP_Municipios_2025_with 6 digit/SP_Municipios_2025/SP_Municipios_2025.shp"

# Read Parquet file
sisagua <- read_parquet(parquet_path)

# Read São Paulo municipality shapefile
sp_mun <- st_read(shapefile_path, quiet = TRUE)

# Check column names if needed
names(sisagua)
names(sp_mun)
```


# Prepare Sisauga Data 

```{r}
years_keep <- c(2014, 2017, 2021, 2024)

sisagua_map <- sisagua %>%
  mutate(
    cod_ibge = as.character(cod_ibge),
    ano = as.integer(ano),
    sisagua_pct_deteccao = as.numeric(sisagua_pct_deteccao)
  ) %>%
  filter(ano %in% years_keep) %>%
  group_by(cod_ibge, nome_municipio, ano) %>%
  summarise(
    sisagua_pct_deteccao = mean(sisagua_pct_deteccao, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sisagua_pct_deteccao = ifelse(
      is.nan(sisagua_pct_deteccao),
      NA,
      sisagua_pct_deteccao
    )
  )
```


```{r}

sp_mun_clean <- sp_mun %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(
    cod_ibge = as.character(COD_6)
  )

```


## Join data to shapefile

```{r}
sp_map <- sp_mun_clean %>%
  left_join(sisagua_map, by = "cod_ibge")
```

## Create choropleth map

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
p_map <- ggplot(sp_map) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = sisagua_pct_deteccao),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ ano, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#ffffb2", "#fecc5c", "#fd8d3c", "#f03b20", "#bd0026"),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "75%", "100%"),
    na.value = "grey85",
    name = "Samples with\nquantifiable\ndetection"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Percentage of Samples with Quantifiable Detection",
    subtitle = "Municipalities of São Paulo, Brazil, 2014, 2017, 2021, and 2024",
    caption = "Grey areas indicate missing data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
